coreCoverage.rule: Include the complete current Title 8 CFR.
coreCoverage.rationale: Title 8 CFR is the principal codified regulatory title for immigration and nationality law.

crossTitleCoverage.rule: From the Parallel Table of Authorities and Rules, include every non-Title-8 CFR part whose 8 U.S.C. locator intersects a Title 8 U.S.C. record retained in the statutory corpus.

limitations: GovInfo states that the PTAR is based on agency-supplied authority citations and cannot be considered all-inclusive.
The cross-title rule is keyed to all retained Title 8 U.S.C. records, not only sections currently mapped to the INA.
A part can be relevant to immigration practice without appearing in the PTAR-selected set; such additions require an explicit reviewed policy revision.
Runtime eCFR maintenance refreshes this fixed reviewed coverage and does not discover newly mapped parts.
refreshGate: Generation requires reviewed PTAR year 2025 and fails on any added, missing, or newly removed cross-title part until this policy is updated.
